workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description: Welcome to the final week before the re-test in the gymnastics progression. Consider in the progression sessions to go as hard as you can based on how the last few weeks have gone for you. This is the week that should hit the absolute hardest from a volume standpoint. That said, be smart and have some fun.

workouts.title: Barbell Cycling
workouts.description:
@50%

Death by:
2-4-6-8-10...
Hang Power Clean
Push Jerk

On minute 1, perform 2 Hang Power Clean + 2 Push Jerk. on minute 2, perform 4 Hang Power Clean + 4 Push Jerk. And so on until you cannot complete the reps on the minute.
